diagnosis: The check C5 passed in three out of four rollouts because the model defaulted to enabling the accelerated depreciation election (PF2). This default setting allowed the model to satisfy the requirement for the accelerated depreciation election without needing the hidden information provided by PF2.

C5.why: Without PF2, the purchase-versus-lease choice and accelerated-depreciation election have no identified tax basis; PF2 changes the required funding choice to purchase, turns the election on, and requires election documentation.
